verdict.rationale: Remote-desktop SaaS products with a REST API and management console could reasonably offer a sandbox or test account, so this axis applies. The evidence documents only a CLI and a REST API that operate on the live account (session history, clients, address books). Nothing describes a sandbox, test tenant, or isolated non-production environment, and nothing describes a dry-run mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
